display.purpose: Page titles and hero numbers (Session Complete, stat values).

headline.purpose: Card titles and section leads (Today's Plan).

label.purpose: Captions, chips, stat labels, muted metadata. Sentence case.

shadows.name: card-resting
shadows.purpose: Default barely-there lift under a content card.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Tactile hover response on interactive cards (pair with -translate-y-0.5).

shadows.name: app-frame
shadows.purpose: Floats the phone-width column above the canvas on desktop (>=768px).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions. No bounce, no overshoot.

motion.name: page-enter
motion.purpose: Route/page arrival; a single quiet crossfade, not a choreographed sequence.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global reset; every animation degrades to instant.

breakpoints.name: app-frame
breakpoints.purpose: Below: full-width phone column. At/above: framed column with rails + ambient shadow.

layout.name: app-max
layout.purpose: Max width of the centered app column. The whole app is phone-width, deliberately.

layout.name: nav-height
layout.purpose: Fixed bottom-nav height; main content pads by this + safe-area-inset-bottom.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one loud element per screen: primary action, indigo, solid.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet outline action; transparent fill, slate border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #334155; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 0.75rem; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f1f5f9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Full hairline border + tonal fill. Never a colored side-stripe, never nested.
components.html:
Today's Plan

3 cards due for review
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgb(226 232 240 / 0.7); border-radius: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); padding: 1rem; } .ds-card-title { color: #1e293b; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; margin: 0 0 0.25rem; } .ds-card-body { color: #64748b; font-size: 0.875rem; margin: 0; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter; indigo when selected, slate outline when not.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #fff; color: #334155; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.375rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #f1f5f9; } .ds-chip-selected { background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; border-color: #4f46e5; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Slate stroke, indigo focus ring. Always paired with a label or aria-label.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fff; color: #1e293b; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 0.5rem; outline: none; transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #6366f1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(129 140 248 / 0.6); }

components.name: Grade Buttons
components.description: The SRS core loop: four semantic effort chips, clean full borders, no gradients. Traffic-light meaning without judgement.
components.css: .ds-grades { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-grade { font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; min-height: 52px; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-grade:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-grade-again { background: #fff7ed; color: #c2410c; border: 1px solid #fed7aa; } .ds-grade-hard { background: #fffbeb; color: #b45309; border: 1px solid #fde68a; } .ds-grade-good { background: #f0fdf4; color: #15803d; border: 1px solid #bbf7d0; } .ds-grade-easy { background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; }

components.name: Bottom Nav Item
components.description: Emoji + label tab; indigo active with a sliding indicator, slate inactive. Lives on glass chrome.
components.html: 📊Home🃏Review📚Words
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-top: 1px solid rgb(226 232 240 / 0.6); padding: 0.25rem 0; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.125rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.375rem; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #64748b; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-icon { font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-nav-active { color: #4f46e5; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-active .ds-nav-icon { transform: scale(1.1); }

narrative.overview: LangLearn is a patient, encouraging tutor rendered as software: a companion for learning Japanese, Russian, and beyond that celebrates effort and never scolds. The philosophy is kind learning — mistakes are met with 'No worries, it'll come back later', not red X's. It is product-register: design serves the task, reaching for earned familiarity over novelty. Personality is carried by warm microcopy and friendly emoji iconography, not decoration. Color is restrained to one indigo accent; depth comes from tonal layering, not heavy shadows; motion conveys state, never spectacle. The app lives in a centered phone-width column that reads as an intentional focused app on any screen. It explicitly rejects the AI-slop aesthetic it was rebuilt away from: rainbow card grids, gradient text, side-stripe borders, uppercase eyebrows, bounce easing, and endless equal-weight card stacks.
keyCharacteristics: Kind, never punishing — gentle language and gentle color; no harsh failure states.
One quiet accent — indigo carries meaning; everything else is neutral slate.
Phone-first, framed on desktop — a single max-w-[34rem] centered column.
Legible above all — WCAG AA contrast is a floor; system fonts, generous 18px base.
Hierarchy over uniformity — one hero action, grouped rows, muted metadata.
Offline-first — no webfonts, no network-dependent chrome.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo-600 is the only brand color. If a screen has a second decorative hue, one is wrong. Green/amber/red communicate state only, never decoration.

rules.name: The Kind Palette Rule
rules.body: Failure is never loud. Misses, wrong answers, and empty states use soft tints and encouraging copy, never a saturated red block.

rules.name: The Slate-Only Rule
rules.body: The neutral ramp is slate, exclusively. Never mix Tailwind gray-* with slate-*.

rules.name: The System-Sans Rule
rules.body: No custom webfonts, ever. This is an offline PWA; weight and size carry all hierarchy.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section headers are normal-case text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500. Uppercase + wide tracking above every section is forbidden; uppercase is for genuine micro-badges only.

rules.name: The Three-Layer Rule
rules.body: Depth = canvas -> frame -> card tonal layering. Reach for a lighter surface before a heavier shadow.

rules.name: The Glass-Is-Chrome-Only Rule
rules.body: backdrop-blur belongs on the sticky header and bottom nav and nowhere else.

dos: Do use indigo-600 as the one accent — primary actions, active state, focus, progress, and text links (indigo-600 for links, not indigo-500).
Do write muted text as text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 and headings as text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100; verify >=4.5:1 contrast.
Do differentiate cards with a full 1px border (border-slate-200/70 dark:border-white/10) plus tonal fill.
Do give every icon-only button an aria-label, every input/select a label, and every control a visible focus-visible state and >=44px touch target.
Do keep content inside the .app-frame and slot overlays into the z-scale (modal 60, toast 70, onboarding 100).
Do fetch runtime content with `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}...` (served under /LangLearn/).
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion and keep transitions ease-out, 150-300ms.
Do keep failure gentle: soft tints + encouraging copy for wrong answers, misses, and empty states.
Do establish hierarchy — one hero action, grouped rows, muted metadata; collapse long lists behind a summary.
donts: Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe. (Absolute ban.)
Don't use gradient text (bg-clip-text + gradient). Solid ink only. (Absolute ban.)
Don't use decorative indigo->violet gradients; the Today's Plan hero is the one exception.
Don't put a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section; use normal-case text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500.
Don't use bounce/overshoot easing (cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, ...)) or animate-bounce; ease-out only, no infinite decorative loops.
Don't stack endless equal-weight rounded-2xl cards; if everything is a card, nothing is grouped.
Don't mix gray-* and slate-*; the neutral ramp is slate, exclusively.
Don't use text-slate-400 or indigo-500 as light-mode body/label text; it fails WCAG AA.
Don't add glassmorphism to content cards — glass is for the sticky header and nav only.
Don't add a custom webfont; this is an offline PWA. System sans only.
